citations.claim: E approach shows green at step 2 while emergency active, 0s after NS was yellow
N approach was yellow at step 1 during NS yellow phase just before preemption
N approach was green at step 0 in NS green phase before emergency

explanation: Emergency preemption at t=1 immediately forces EW green at step 2, skipping the required all-red clearance (0s vs 4s required) and truncating NS yellow to 1s vs 5s required. Inspect shows NS green at step 0, NS yellow at step 1 with emergency active, then EW green at step 2. Likely cause: emergency handler jumps directly to demanded green without enforcing yellow_duration and all_red_seconds transitions.

violation.detail: approach 1 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 4 s)

vision_note: At step 0 one axis is green, at step 1 the same axis turns yellow, then at step 2 the cross axis is already green. No all-red step appears between the yellow and the opposing green, so the switch completes in only one second.
